website.notes: Founded 2002 by Sean Richards, Matt Sambell, James Leckie; began from a conversation between developers and a school; hundreds of schools across more than a dozen countries; customer-relationship staff are trained former educators. Integrations: Edumate, FACTS, KAMAR, Wonde, Civica Education, iSams, Veracross, Compass, Sentral, Synergetic; Microsoft Education & Google Classroom, Intellischool, Geosnapshot, Paperly, Turnitin. Add-ons incl. Schoolbox AI. Careers page: profitable, independent, product-led; hybrid/remote flexibility, mentoring. Contact page: 1300 932 338, no address.
